fixes.cause: Guest PackageManager read the host /config/sdcardfs with an ordinary app UID and crashed when listing returned null
fixes.change: Map /config into the guest filesystem namespace
fixes.verification: Five added filesystem regressions failed on the old libraries; all 75 filesystem checks passed after rebuilding

fixes.cause: Guest VINTF declared a vibrator HAL although the host reported no vibrator hardware
fixes.change: Filter unavailable host HAL declarations using runtime capabilities before hwservicemanager starts
fixes.verification: HostDeviceManifestTest covers available and unavailable devices, manifest versions, transports and unrelated declarations

fixes.cause: AccountManager opened accounts_de.db before vold callbacks created system-user directories
fixes.change: Prepare storage for the guest USER_SYSTEM before registering vold, using the existing directory preparation routine
fixes.verification: Fresh ordinary-UID runtime opened SQLite databases before callbacks; repeated preparation preserved existing data

compatibility.strategy: Use host capabilities and guest framework constants; no host model, UID or SDK-specific exception
compatibility.deviceCoverage: Remote desktop verification on SDK 36 only; other supported host versions remain outside this device result
